title: Newb Download Guide
subheading: Step-by-step guide to using the downloader for the first time.

contents.Text: [[[strong:Downloader -> Settings -> Target Download Dir:]]] Set the folder the downloader will download to.
[[[strong:Tip:]]] You probably want this set to the same path as your search folder.

[[[strong:Downloader -> Settings -> Max Download Threads:]]] The number of concurrent downloads, i.e. how many songs can be downloaded at once. The default is [[[strong:2]]] and you can adjust it to suit your setup.
[[[warning:Note:]]] More threads is not always faster. Websites may apply rate limiting, which can slow or block downloads if you request too much at once.
Only follow this step if you want to download from Spotify.
[[[strong:Downloader -> Settings -> Spotify download all playlists and liked:]]] Tick this to enable Spotify downloads.
[[[warning:Note:]]] This only downloads songs from your own Spotify account, i.e. your playlists and liked songs.
[[[strong:Downloader -> Settings -> Spotfetch_download_selection:]]] Choose what to download from Spotify:

rows: Both your liked songs and your playlists

contents.Text: [[[warning:Note:]]] Hover over the [[[strong:Spotify Disclaimer]]] in the settings before enabling this. A sign-in window will also open in your browser when you start the download.
[[[strong:Downloader -> Playlist Editor -> Closed Dropdown:]]] Select [[[strong:Add key]]] to add a new category, then fill in:
[[[strong:Add Website:]]] Enter the website name (SoundCloud, YouTube, etc.).
[[[strong:Choose Download Executable:]]] Choose the download executable, such as yt-dlp.
[[[strong:Add Codec:]]] Set your preferred codec: AAC, ALAC, FLAC, M4A, MP3, Opus, Vorbis (Ogg) or WAV.
[[[strong:Save:]]] Adds the category and closes the [[[strong:Add key]]] dropdown.
[[[warning:Note:]]] The website name must start with a letter, not a number.
These are the recommended codecs:

rows: The best quality, with larger files

contents.Text: See the [[[button:Codecs][/_Guides/Codecs]]] guide for the full list.
[[[strong:Downloader -> Playlist Editor -> SoundCloud:]]] Click the category you just made to open it.
Then use [[[strong:YT_dlp_args]]] to choose a profile. Profiles are numbered, and clicking one shows its description.

[[[strong:Profile 1]]] is the default, and is always number 1. It is called [[[strong:downloads best audio then converts (slower)]]] and it downloads the best available audio before converting it to your chosen codec.
[[[strong:Tip:]]] Profile 1 is the safest option, so if you are unsure, leave it as it is.
Next, open the [[[strong:Main]]] dropdown and click [[[strong:Add]]] then fill in:
[[[strong:Playlist name:]]] The name of the folder the playlist will be downloaded into.
[[[strong:URL:]]] Direct, playlist and profile playlist URLs all work. See the examples under [[[strong:Main keys]]] on the [[[button:Playlist Editor][/Main Window/Downloader/Playlist Editor]]] page.
Once both fields are filled in, click [[[strong:Save]]] then click [[[strong:Save Changes]]] at the very top to write all your changes to disk.
[[[warning:Note:]]] [[[strong:Save Changes]]] is the only thing that writes your changes to disk, and it is highlighted red while there are changes to save.
[[[strong:Downloader -> Starter -> Regenerate list:]]] Adds any new folders to the order list.
[[[strong:Tip:]]] It is recommended to always [[[strong:Regenerate list]]] before each download, so the order is correct.
Click the [[[strong:item]]] you want to move, then use the [[[strong:up and down arrows]]] on the right to move it.
Folders at the top of the list take priority over folders below them. If the same song exists in more than one folder, it is downloaded into the highest one and the others are skipped.
[[[warning:Note:]]] The arrows with a number next to them move the selected item by that many places.
[[[strong:Downloader -> Starter -> Start:]]] Press [[[strong:Start]]] to begin downloading, then wait.
[[[warning:Note:]]] If Spotify is enabled, a sign-in window opens in your browser.
